mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months compresses discount rates for equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in 60% or more of periods with declining FEDFUNDS (measured as FEDFUNDS change < -0.1% over 3 months).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.0%, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering immediate negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in 60% or more of periods where UNRATE > 5.0.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production and rise in unemployment rate indicates a weakening economy, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction effect (INDPRO decline AND UNRATE rise) fails to predict negative returns in 60% or more of cases (measured by Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows).

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 1.5%), a rising unemployment rate signals economic stress, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 1.5 AND UNRATE rises > 0.1pp in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in 60% or more of periods meeting the trigger condition (FEDFUNDS>1.5 and UNRATE rise>0.1pp).

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in real GDP (GDPC1) signals robust economic growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in 60% or more of periods with positive GDPC1 growth (quarterly YoY change > 1.0%).

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1250 thousand units, it indicates strong consumer demand, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in 60% or more of periods where HOUST > 1250.

mechanism_narrative: In a low unemployment regime (UNRATE < 4.5%), a rising employment level (PAYEMS) signals a tight labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in 60% or more of periods meeting the trigger condition (UNRATE < 4.5).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction effect (HOUST rise AND RSAFS rise) fails to predict positive returns in 60% or more of cases (measured by Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows).
